results.title: Green Party Leader Faces Storm Over Comments on Israel, Zionism
results.description: Zack Polanski, Green Party leader, denied Israel's right to exist and labelled Zionism a racist ideology, sparking internal party conflict, public backlash, and a steep fall in his polling numbers. His stance, made during his first major TV interview since a scandal over his party's stance on Zionism, challenges the party's own motion describing Zionism as racist and calls for a Palestinian state. The controversy has also led to calls for his resignation and threatens coalition ties with Labour. His popularity plummets marked by a negative public rating of 52% and a net favourability of minus 36. Despite his criticism of the motion, Polanski said he would not alter it until the next party vote in 2028, citing democratic procedure. The incident highlights the intense political divide over Israel and Palestine within the UK and illustrates the risks and challenges of addressing contentious political issues.

results.title: Tar Heels Reclaim Victory Bell in Second‑Half Surge Over Duke
results.description: The University of North Carolina's football team fought back from a 17‑point deficit to win 24-20 against the Duke Blue Devils, restoring the Victory Bell rivalry trophy after dropping it earlier in the year. The game featured a dramatic defensive collapse by Duke and a resilient offense run by senior quarterback Billy Edwards Jr., as well as notable defensive insights from former NFL coach Bill Belichick who was in attendance. The match showcased UNC's ability to adjust while dealing with injuries to key player Benjamin Hall and exploited Duke's run‑heavy offense led by Nate Sheppard. The victory places UNC back into the spotlight for the remainder of the season.
